question: What change in intercalation energy does the DFT give and at what in-plane strain, what potential change was measured and at what in-plane prestrain, and what is the ratio of computed to measured change?
rendered:
A change in intercalation energy of ∼75 meV (∼75 mV) was calculated with an applied in-plane strain of +1.5% on the V2O5 lattice (Figure 4d), comparable to the measured change in potential of ∼40 mV at about ∼1.66% in-plane prestrain in Figure 4b.

The ratio of computed to measured change is calculated as follows:

Computed change: 75 meV (∼75 mV)
Measured change: 40 mV

Ratio = (75 mV) / (40 mV) ≈ 1.875
